''See also: [[Blood Shadow Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A Blood [[Shadow]] is a [[spiritual parasite]] originating from the [[Dreadgod]] known as the [[Bleeding Phoenix]]. These entities function as [[hunger spirits]] that seek out hosts to consume their power, which is then returned to [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]]. While most [[Blood Shadows]] eventually drain their hosts dry and leave them as empty husks, some rare individuals manage to establish a symbiotic relationship with the entity. There are several ways these shadows manifest and are managed by their hosts. The most common and easiest to control is a formless version, created by feeding the [[Shadow|shadow]] primarily with [[blood madra]]. Another method involves feeding the entity actual [[blood]] to allow it to grow into a monstrous, bestial form, such as a [[blood]] [[dragon]] or a predatory beast. The most advanced and difficult form is a true Blood [[Shadow]], which acts as an absolute copy of the host—a second body that possesses its own will and powers while remaining perfectly coordinated with the user. In combat, a Blood [[Shadow]] can serve as an extra ally, mimicking the host's techniques and physical appearance. However, they are inherently dangerous; they can be unpredictable, occasionally attempting to break free from the host's [[spirit]] or consume them entirely. They are also capable of producing [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]], which are red, puppet-like [[constructs]] made of [[blood madra]] that act as servants or hunters.}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|The Blood [[Shadow]] is a [[spiritual parasite]] that [[Eithan]] slipped into the [[Skysworn]]. While it functions as an uncontrollable puppet like a [[Bloodspawn|bloodspawn]], it is also a [[technique]] that [[Yerin]] can control. This entity feels like a liquid to the touch and possesses fingertips shaped by her [[sword madra]], though it leaves no residue on the skin. As a parasite, it seeks to drain its host dry to return power to the [[Bleeding Phoenix]], eventually attempting to wear the host like a suit or become a [[blood]]-clone of them. During an encounter, the [[Shadow|shadow]] contorted into a humanoid shape and slammed [[Lindon]] into a wall, though he was protected by a sheath of liquid [[yellow madra]] when it latched onto his arm.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|A Blood [[Shadow]] is an internal power that resides within a person, such as [[Yerin]], [[Longhook]], or [[Yan Shoumei]]. While the [[Skysworn]] view them as potentially dangerous liabilities, these entities can fight independently or mimic their user's actions. [[Yerin]]'s specific Blood [[Shadow]] appears as a red-tinted [[Shadow|shadow]] resembling a jagged, painted [[Remnant]] version of herself. This entity can be used as a cloak by a young woman, and it possesses thin arms that flatten into blades. In combat, [[Yerin's Blood Shadow]] can cling to a target like a [[monkey]] to a tree by driving its clawed hands and [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]] into their body, eventually spreading those [[Goldsign|Goldsigns]].}}

{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|Cultivated by the [[Sage of Red Faith]], the Blood [[Shadow]] is a parasitic [[spirit]] that acts as a mirror to its host and can be upgraded through the use of a [[Heaven's Drop]]. This version of the entity appears as a copy of [[Riyusai Meira|Meira]] with pink skin, bright red hair, and red irises set against almost white eye whites. == Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A Blood [[Shadow]] is a vicious, evil [[spirit]] that can manifest in human form and acts as a parasitic mass of [[blood madra]]. While [[Yan Shoumei]]'s Blood [[Shadow]] appeared as a mysterious, cloak-like entity, the one residing within [[Yerin]] escaped her [[spirit]] and displayed a monstrous nature. This specific Blood [[Shadow]] possesses bright red hair, [[ruby]] eyes, and the ability to use a black blade or a red-tinged [[Rippling Sword]]. It can steal power by killing or possessing others to return it to the [[Bleeding Phoenix]], and its body is capable of re-forming even after its head is destroyed. Though it can attempt to take over a host's body, [[Yerin]] is able to send power to her Blood [[Shadow]] through the [[Blood Sage]]'s [[technique]].}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A Blood [[Shadow]] is a symbiotic [[spirit]] that takes on the traits of whatever it consumes, manifesting as a [[ring]]-shaped entity that beats in unison with its host's heart. These entities can be used as a [[technique]] to cover a weapon, or they may appear in various forms, such as the snake held by an [[Archlady]]. As a monstrous blob-like presence in the sky, a Blood [[Shadow]] is capable of consuming a leviathan and leaving behind nothing but a husk. While raw Shadows from [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]] are easier to digest, the act of killing and feeding on another person's Blood [[Shadow]] is a crime punishable by expulsion from a sect. Furthermore, these entities are specifically associated with the members of [[Redmoon Hall]].}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Blatantly killing and feeding on another's [[Blood Shadow]] is grounds for expulsion from the sect.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9">''Dreadgod'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|A raw [[Shadow]] from [[The Phoenix|the Phoenix]] is easier to digest.<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c9" />}}</li>

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A Blood [[Shadow]] was observed melting away from a mace constructed of dark metal. This entity eventually became known as [[Ruby]], following its connection to [[Yerin]]. While the [[Remnant]] claimed responsibility for planting a Blood [[Shadow]], the entity demonstrated the ability to take the form of a [[sacred artist]]. Ultimately, this Blood [[Shadow]] was responsible for the deaths of [[Yerin]]'s family.}}

== Threshold: Stories from Cradle ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The Blood [[Shadow]] is a specialized [[technique]] capable of manifesting with its own independence. This power serves as the primary source of strength for [[Yan Shoumei]], who maintains a Blood [[Shadow]] nestled within her [[soulspace]]. Beyond [[Yan Shoumei]], the entity is also possessed by [[Kahn Mala]]. Furthermore, the Blood [[Shadow]] represents a specific type of role or entity to which [[Crusher]] belongs.}}
